provenance.paper_title: CompILE: Compositional Imitation Learning and Execution
provenance.notes: Source native vector geometry and glyph outlines preserved, with minimal crop padding to avoid edge labels. Outlined labels can be moved/recolored/point-edited but are not live text; original architecture and separate mathematical components retained. Freeform arrows are not attached semantic connectors. No raster figure background. Fourteen ordinary outlined source labels were transcribed and restored as native typeable text; mathematical notation and vertical title glyphs retain source outlines. Small font-metric differences are expected.
